blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water Foundation, the social development arm of Manila Water Company, has recently completed a series of WASH Paaralan sessions under its Lunas hygiene education program to celebrate World Toilet Day 2026. The handover of essential WASH donations to school campuses, designed to safeguard the health of young girls, served as the highlight of this year’s celebration. Aligned with the World Toilet Day 2026 theme, “Safe Toilets. Equal Futures,” this year’s WASH Paaralan sessions emphasized how access to safe, clean, and private toilets — alongside menstrual hygiene soap products and water — protects the health, safety, and dignity […]...
